args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py (test_half_even) to fail.
Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (`2.665 -> 2.66`) per FIN-212, but `round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite the docstring already claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Fix
Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py` so the implementation matches the documented FIN-212 requirement and the tests.

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986` (includes `test_half_even`).
